title: Urea

review.note: Drafted from the source below; not yet reviewed by a medical professional.

measures: Urea is a normal waste product made when the body breaks down protein. The kidneys remove it from the blood into urine. Some reports show urea, and others show blood urea nitrogen (BUN), which measures the nitrogen part of urea.
context: Levels vary with sex and usually rise with age, and are often read with creatinine and eGFR. A result outside the reported range does not always mean there is a condition that needs treatment.
aboveRange: Changes in how well the kidneys remove waste
Burns, or a recent heart event
belowRange: A diet low in protein, or poor nutrition
nextStep: Discuss this result with your doctor.
